body:
This may also happen when Claude Code needs to update.
Need a fix for when this occurs while trying to assign a task:

agent exited without finishing (exit status: 1):

Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed

### Goal

When an agent can't start or stops because its sign-in expired, it needs an update, or its program is missing, the task shows a plain message saying what happened and what to do. For example: "Claude's sign-in has expired. Open Claude Code once and sign in, then press Try again." Don't show the raw exit text. Keep the raw text under the task's technical details.

### Notes

- Reuse the usage-limit detection and its **Try again** (`board/agents.rs`, `board/usage-limits.json`) rather than adding a second mechanism.
- An expired sign-in also marks the model as unavailable in the model list, with the reason, until Try again succeeds.
title: agents: plain messages for sign-in failures
